name: FM bell
description: VCO 1 at a non-octave ratio frequency-modulates a sine on VCO 2. Clangy, metallic bell with a long decay.
tidal: d1 $ n "0 ~ 7 ~ 12 ~ 4 ~" # s "scstd" # o1oct 0.485 # o1lvl 0 # o2wave 3 # o2fm 0.12 # vcfcut 12000 # vcfenv 0 # aratk 0.001 # arrel 2.5 # erel 2.5 # legato 0.1
